{"id":2041708775,"question_id":4318,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month","timestamp":1782107769,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2041708775/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Valid Subarrays With Matching Sum Digits I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countValidSubarrays(vector<int>& nums, int x) {\n        vector<int>pref(nums.size() , 0);\n        pref[0] = nums[0];\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<nums.size() ; i++) pref[i] = pref[i-1] + nums[i];\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = i ; j<nums.size() ; j++)\n            {\n                int sum = pref[j] - ((i-1) >= 0 ? pref[i-1] : 0);\n                bool lastdigit = false;\n                bool firstdigit = false;\n\n                if(sum < 10 and sum == x) count++;\n\n                while(sum >= 10)\n                {\n                    int digit = sum % 10;\n                    if(!lastdigit and digit == x) lastdigit = true;\n                    sum /= 10;\n                }\n                if(!firstdigit and sum == x) firstdigit = true;\n\n                if(firstdigit and lastdigit) count++;\n            }\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"valid-subarrays-with-matching-sum-digits-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2203}
